simple.meaning: עָשׁ (ʻâsh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a moth.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Job 4:19. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשׁ (H6211) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עָשׁ (ʻâsh) / H6211 is traced through Job 4:19, Job 13:28, Job 27:18, Psalms 39:12 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H6211. ash II. עָשׁ noun masculine Isa 50:9 moth (as waster, consumer ); — ׳ע absolute, Hosea 5:12 (|| רָקָכ ), Isa 50:9 ; 51:8 ; in simile Psa 39:12 ; עָשׁ אֲכָלוֺ כְּבֶגֶד Job 13:28 ; symbol of fragility 4:19 . — 27:10 read probably עַכָּבִישׁ q. v.

occurrences.englishText: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay,
though I am decaying like a rotten thing,
He builds his house as the moth,
“Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry.
Behold, the Lord Yahweh will help me!
For the moth will eat them up like a garment,

The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
it is you, O king, that have grown and become strong; for your greatness has grown, and reaches to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.
At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky; until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.
Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth,
